facts: three small AMBER glass bottles, 10 mL each (1/3 FL. OZ. (10 mL)), same shape: round, straight sides, rounded shoulder, short neck

each bottle has a BLACK ribbed screw cap; the flat cap top carries a small round sticker in the label colour with the scent name (Christmas Tree pink, Vanilla Spice peach-beige); with the cap off, a black ring stays on the neck and a small clear-white plastic dropper insert sits in the opening (drops come out one at a time); no dropper bulb, no pump, no roller ball
each label wraps the middle of the bottle, a black band of bare glass shows below it and amber glass above it

Christmas Tree: hot PINK label, a big chartreuse YELLOW-GREEN Christmas tree with a yellow star on top and pale aqua dots, small white snowflakes; dark green text 'Plant Therapy' at top, 'Christmas Tree' big dark green, 'ESSENTIAL OIL BLEND', a white rounded pill 'KidSafe', '1/3 FL. OZ. (10 mL)'

Sugar Plum Fairy: soft LAVENDER label with a big cream-peach rounded blob, small purple four-point stars and orange dots; dark green 'Plant Therapy', 'Sugar Plum Fairy' big dark green, 'ESSENTIAL OIL BLEND', white pill 'KidSafe', '1/3 FL. OZ. (10 mL)'

Vanilla Spice: CREAM label with a big taupe-brown circle, a dark plum vanilla pod crossing on the left, olive-green leaves, a cinnamon stick top right, small plum and dark green dots; dark green 'Plant Therapy', 'Vanilla Spice' big dark green, 'ESSENTIAL OIL BLEND', NO KidSafe pill, '1/3 FL. OZ. (10 mL)'

box: white square-front carton with small pink, orange, purple and green stars and a thin line ornament; dark text 'Plant Therapy', 'Christmas Cheer', 'Essential Oil Blend Set', 'Christmas Tree, Sugar Plum Fairy, & Vanilla Spice', '1 FL OZ / 30 mL (3 X 1/3 FL OZ (10 mL))'
use: diffuse 3-4 drops per 100 mL of water; topical only diluted (Tree and Sugar Plum 2-4%, Vanilla Spice 1-2% in a carrier); Vanilla Spice 'shake well before use'

size: maker does not publish bottle dimensions (checked 2026-10-30); a standard 10 mL amber bottle is about 2.5 cm wide and about 6 cm tall with the cap, about the height of a lipstick, it fits in a closed hand
hand scale (real creator video @annmarieeckhart): one bottle is about as tall as an adult's thumb plus the palm pad; three bottles fit side by side in one palm
